# Theme gallery and credits

Every theme in this project comes from
[PrismJS/prism-themes](https://github.com/PrismJS/prism-themes) (MIT license).
The list below is taken from the upstream README: the screenshots show the
original Prism rendering, which is exactly what MacDown 3000 uses for code
blocks in the preview, and the credits name the designers of each theme. The
editor themes (`Themes/`) and preview styles (`Styles/`) of this project are
derived from the same colours.

In MacDown the themes appear under the names below, with three exceptions:
`VS Code Dark+` is called `VS Code Dark Plus`, `Synthwave '84` is called
`Synthwave 84` and `Ateliersulphurpool-light` is called
`Atelier Sulphurpool Light`.
